question: At matched K=3 actor and critic work, does re-centering pi_3 on the newly updated pi_2 improve deployment return over keeping the pi_1 reference?

recenter: pi_2 references the freshly updated pi_1
pi_3 references the freshly updated pi_2
fixed_ref: pi_2 references the freshly updated pi_1
pi_3 references the freshly updated pi_1

primary_outcome: paired final d4rl_pi3(recenter) minus d4rl_pi3(fixed_ref) for each environment, T and seed
aggregation: Report each environment x T four-seed paired mean and sample SD; overall report an equal-weight mean over the 27 environment x T cell means, alongside the full signed cell table. No best-seed or best-T selection.

pilot.purpose: Verify identical critic, first actor, targets, optimizer state, RNG and update counts, plus differing pi_3 reference; not a performance test.

identity_gate: The two trusted per-branch checkpoints match bitwise on first actor and optimizer, critic and optimizer, target actor and critic, RNG and dataset normalization; actor update counts match at 1024 and 1000000 steps.
missing_or_failed_runs: Keep missing pairs visible; do not choose the better branch or splice historical BAR, fixed_reference or data_anchor scores.
interpretation: A consistent positive paired difference supports a benefit of sequential recentering under this TD3+BC protocol; mixed or imprecise differences do not establish equivalence. Frozen-critic experiments are outside this primary comparison.
